channel.title: Practical AI
channel.description:
Making artificial intelligence practical, productive & accessible to everyone. Practical AI is a show in which technology professionals, business people, students, enthusiasts, and expert guests engage in lively discussions about Artificial Intelligence and related topics (Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Neural Networks, GANs, MLOps, AIOps, LLMs & more).
The focus is on productive implementations and real-world scenarios that are accessible to everyone. If you want to keep up with the latest advances in AI, while keeping one foot in the real world, then this is the show for you!

item.title: Building Human-Centered AI
item.itunes:title: Building Human-Centered AI
item.description:
How can enterprises adopt AI and agentic systems while keeping people, business value, and trust at the center?

Chris is joined by Dr. Gautham Pallapa, Principal Director of AI and Innovation at Scotiabank and author of Invaluable, to explore how organizations can approach AI-driven transformation. They discuss identifying meaningful opportunities for AI in highly regulated industries like banking, rethinking developer productivity, and using multi-agent systems to bring different roles and capabilities together.

Featuring: 

  • Dr. Gautham Pallapa – LinkedIn
  • Chris Benson – Website, LinkedIn, Bluesky, GitHub, X

Links:

  • Invaluable: Define Value. Align Execution. Deliver Outcomes

Sponsors:

  • Framer: The enterprise-grade website builder that lets your team ship faster. Get 30% off at framer.com/practicalai
  • Granola: An AI-powered notepad that makes your meeting notes useful. It captures what happens in your meetings and turns it into clean, structured notes with decisions and action items pulled out and made easy to find.  You can try it totally free—head to granola.ai/PRACTICALAI. 

Resources and Events:

  • Register for upcoming webinars here!
  • Prior Webinars from our partner Prediction Guard
  • Midwest AI Summit 2026

Chris’s new book The Art of Swarming will be published soon, written to be the seminal foundational book for the fledgling swarming industry, defining the principles and architecture that enable autonomous agentic UxS swarms with emergent distributed embodied intelligence.  You can find out more at his website:  https://chrisbenson.com

item.title: Abundant Intelligence at the Midwest AI Summit Part 2
item.itunes:title: Abundant Intelligence at the Midwest AI Summit Part 2
item.description:
How do organizations decide what AI should do, where to set boundaries, and when to keep humans in control? In this special episode, we bring you three more talks from the Midwest AI Summit, exploring how organizations are putting AI into practice. Don Barger of the International Mission Board shares how establishing an AI charter helped define what the organization would and wouldn't use AI for. Mark Lay of Noblis explores four key decisions for managing AI across an organization, from delegation and accountability to technical debt. And Darren Taillie of Aerocore Technologies walks through how his team uses AI agents, text-to-SQL, and vision models to improve data access and automate work order verification.

Featuring: 

  • Don Barger – LinkedIn
  • Mark Lay – LinkedIn
  • Darren Taillie – LinkedIn
  • Daniel Whitenack – Website, GitHub, X

Links:

  • Noblis
  • International Mission Board
  • AeroCore Technologies

Sponsors:

  • SerpAPI: A Web Search API that gives developers real-time, structured access to search engine results. Visit serpapi.com/practicalai to get started for free and get 250 searches every month.

  • Midwest AI Summit 2026
